one_line: Leader of the Dal Khalsa and prominent Misl-era Sikh confederate chief in 18th‑century Punjab.

appearance.age_look: late 40s to early 50s, lean but broad-shouldered, battle-hardened and upright
appearance.face: oval face with a strong jaw, wheatish Punjabi complexion, thick arched eyebrows, deep-set determined eyes, straight prominent nose, neatly groomed medium-length beard slightly streaked with grey, default expression calm but resolute with a hint of stern compassion
appearance.hair: dark brown hair fully covered under a deep navy-blue domed turban, wrapped in compact late‑Mughal Punjabi style with a mustard-gold cloth band at the base and a small steel khanda emblem at the front, a simple white under-turban peeking slightly at the edges
appearance.costume: He wears a long knee-length angarkha-style kurta of rich but worn indigo cotton with side ties and a modest round neckline, over which sits a sleeveless steel chestplate shaped to the torso with minimal fluting; a saffron cotton chadar is draped from his left shoulder across the chest and around the back for warmth and modesty; his lower body is in pleated off-white Punjabi-style choridar pyjamas tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots; around his waist is a broad dark brown leather kamarband with a couple of small functional pouches and simple steel buckles, and on his wrists are plain steel kara bangles, with no ostentatious jewelry beyond a small metallic coin-pouch hanging at his left hip to suggest the Lahori and Amritsari Sikh mints.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Sikh talwar with a steel blade and a traditional disc pommel hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, carried sheathed in a plain steel scabbard with minimal engraving and a simple belt loop, usually held resting upright in his right hand to symbolize martial leadership of the Dal Khalsa.

ref_desc: Jassa Singh Ahluwalia is a wheatish-complexioned, middle-aged Sikh leader with a navy-blue turban, neatly groomed greying beard, indigo angarkha, steel chestplate, saffron chadar, off-white choridar, brown boots, leather belt with coin-pouch, and a sheathed Sikh talwar in steel grey and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Jassa Singh Ahluwalia as an 18th-century Sikh confederate leader from Punjab: a wheatish-complexioned, middle-aged man with an oval face, strong jaw, deep determined eyes and a neatly groomed beard slightly streaked with grey. His hair is fully covered by a deep navy-blue domed turban wrapped in compact late-Mughal Punjabi style, with a mustard-gold band at the base, a small steel khanda emblem at the front, and a hint of white under-turban at the edges. He wears a knee-length indigo cotton angarkha kurta with side ties, over which sits a modest steel chestplate shaped to his torso; a saffron cotton chadar is draped from his left shoulder across the chest and around his back, covering the armour in places and emphasizing his leadership. His lower body is dressed in off-white pleated choridar pyjamas tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots. Around his waist is a broad dark brown leather kamarband belt with small functional pouches and simple steel buckles, plus a small coin-pouch at his left hip hinting at Sikh mints. On his wrists are plain steel kara bangles. His signature weapon is a slightly curved Sikh talwar with a steel blade and disc-pommel hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, sheathed in a plain steel scabbard with minimal engraving, held upright in his right hand as a symbol of Dal Khalsa martial authority. Present him in a neutral stance with front, side, and back views to show the navy-blue turban, indigo angarkha, steel chestplate, saffron chadar, off-white choridar, brown boots, leather belt with coin-pouch, and sheathed talwar, using an indigo, saffron, off-white, steel grey, and brown leather palette.
